Trombonist and arranger Wayne Andre was born in Manchester, Connecticut on November 17, 1931. He toured and recorded with big bands led by Charlie Spivak, Woody Herman and Benny Goodman and played an important role in the Kai Winding Septet. Wayne has been a first call trombonist in the New York City recording scene for three decades and currently arranges for a variety of ensembles across the country.
Wayne was interviewed in New York City on January 7, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in Manhattan for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have veteran trombonist Wayne Andre with me.
Pleased to be here and honored to be here.
